sources.title: Feature request: show size of unified memory available to GPU ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: So the fix shape is clear: on macOS, query the effective GPU-available memory (Metal's recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize, with the iogpu.wired_limit_mb sysctl as a cross-check) and display it alongside the total, e.g. GPU: Apple M1 Max (unified memory, 26.0 GB GPU-available of 32.0 GB shared, Metal).
